title: Repair event sequence and timestamp regression across parser and sink
prompt: Repair the regression across `src/parser.rs` and `src/sink.rs`. The telemetry pipeline in `src/event.rs` defines `TelemetryEvent { sequence: u64, timestamp: String, payload: String }`. In `src/parser.rs`, the parser hardcodes sequence numbers to 0 instead of assigning incrementing monotonic sequences starting at 1. In `src/sink.rs`, the continuity check improperly validates sequences and fails to track current sequence state. Fix both files so that events are assigned monotonic 1-based sequences and validated by the sink. Ensure `cargo test` passes cleanly.
acceptance: All pipeline integration tests in tests/test_pipeline.rs pass cleanly
